title: Coefficient action of the normalized projective line counit
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring annihilated by N, S a scheme on which N is invertible, t a normalized finite twist transport, and D an OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-data]. For arbitrary unbounded H,K, the actual counit of D commutes with the ordinary coefficient-first proper projection [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], inverse derived tensor associator and inverse tensor pullback comparison. Equivalently this is the counit square for the specified properStrength.

source.place: last paragraph: projection formula on chosen compactifications and the ordered affine-line tower; categorical calculations making coefficient normalization explicit

proof.text:
the finite-coefficient proper projection theorem makes every ordered
projection invertible. Replace the constant single complex in normalization by
the derived monoidal unit using its canonical isomorphism. The associativity of
the actual ordered proper projection and normalizedTensorCounit_action give the
stated action identity. The tensorator is precisely the inverse of
ordinaryFiniteTensorPullback, so no choice of comparison or trace occurs.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFiniteP1Counit_tensorAction
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (D : OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t S hS)
    (H K : DerivedCategoryModule A S) :
    (OrdinaryAffineTensorActions.properActionNat A S H).app
        ((ordinaryFiniteP1Right A N hA S).obj K) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map
        (OrdinaryAffineTensorActions.properStrength A N hA S H K).hom ≫
      D.adjunction.counit.app (((ordinaryFiniteTensor A S).obj H).obj K) =
        ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A S).obj H).map (D.adjunction.counit.app K)
